_about: Calibrated joints for the rubber-hose rig (2026-10-14), in the body art's pixels (top-left origin, 512 canvas, ground at 256,444). They override points.json. Shoulders: the arm's joint, centred under the top of each sleeve (sleeve top + 18 px, the sleeve tube's radius), measured from Astra's original art. Wrists: where the hands hang at rest, just outside the body's outline at hand height (the apron flares, so the arms angle out along it) in the front, back and diagonal views; the side view's near hand hangs at his side, over the body. Left/right are his own. Head-on the sleeves and upper arms are drawn behind the body, so the apron straps lie over them as in the original painting (Kevin preferred this silhouette to shoulders moved outside the straps). Diagonals: the far arm (behind the body) hangs from the torso's back edge nearly straight down, so only its hand peeks out beside the hip. The far arm is a little shorter (its hand 16 px higher) so it doesn't read as bigger than the near one (Kevin).
